verdict.rationale: Pendo's own Data Sync product exports Pendo data straight to Snowflake or to cloud storage (S3, Azure, Google Cloud), which covers the warehouse-export path of the story. The evidence does not say whether export runs continuously or on a recurring schedule rather than one-off, nor that it covers raw event-level data. Nothing shows querying warehouse tables from inside Pendo. Missing for 10: documented continuous/recurring export cadence, explicit event-level export schema, in-product warehouse querying, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can sync events between the platform and my own data warehouse (query warehouse tables in-product or export events continuously to it)

citations.quote: Send your data direct to Snowflake, no engineering required—or configure your export for cloud storage.
Centralize insights from Pendo directly into Snowflake, S3, Azure, or Google Cloud
